column1: # Biblical, classical and mythical place names whose modern homonyms (Sodom WV, Emmaus PA, Memphis TN, Troja in Prague ...) are traps.
# A place of the atlas (an edition's local place or a model point) whose name is one of these keys must lie in the region given here, else it is
# unplaced at build time unless data/curation/homonym_fixes.json keeps it (action keep) after a reading of the text. Read by ratlas.curation.
# key = the name folded (lower case, no accents, no punctuation). region = one or more of the boxes of ratlas.curation.REGIONS, joined by |;
# NONE = a mythical or imaginary place that has no point at all. Names with a frequent real European homonym (Sion, Susa, Tabor, Nicaea,
# Alexandria/Alessandria, Eden river) are left out on purpose: the far-homonym rule and the per-edition outlier check see them.
